title: Cedar Court schedules a sink repair
caller_intent: Schedule a maintenance visit for a kitchen leak

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Sam Ortiz, the manager at Cedar Court Apartments. I'm calling Alex Kim about the unit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: This is an AI assistant for Alex Kim, and this call may be recorded. What is going on at the unit?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A neighbor noticed a slow drip under the kitchen sink. I'd like to schedule a plumber. There is no fee, and this is not about rent or the lease.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can check free windows for a visit. I won't share other personal details.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wednesday between 1 and 3, or Thursday between 9 and 11. Alex does not have to be home if we may enter. The office line is 206-555-0172.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Wednesday from 1 to 3 is free. Should I book the plumber then?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, book Wednesday from 1 to 3. If that stops working, Alex can call the office. I don't need a card or an account number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Wednesday from 1 to 3 is booked for the sink repair.
